verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is the Authy API/SDK, which lets developers add two-factor authentication to their own apps. It does not expose the app's user-facing functions such as managing tokens, devices, backups or edits, so there is no evidence of API parity with the UI. That API is also closed to new customers and slated for deprecation, and community reports say users cannot even export their data except through hacky workarounds.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: So you don't have to use the Authy API directly to integrate two-factor authentication into your app, we provide an SDK for common web languages.
The Authy API is now closed to new customers and will be fully deprecated in the future.
